snippet.title: DEAD TRUST Official Trailer - PSX Horror game
snippet.description:
DEAD TRUST Official trailer - Available Today on ITCH.IO
Created by Hexnut Studios

DEAD TRUST is a short PSX-style horror game that takes place during a night that goes unexpectedly wrong.

Playtime: 30–40 minutes.
